scripts.dev: bun run --cwd backend/server dev & bun run --cwd backend/background-worker dev & bun run --cwd frontend dev & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run build --prefix backend/shared && npx --prefix backend tsc -p backend/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
